capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Sibling basis: the 2021 Model Y Standard Range pack is the 2,976-cell Panasonic 21700 NCA pack of the Model 3 Standard Range Plus (evspecifications page for the Model Y SR lists 2,976 cells, 21700, NCA, 360 V); EV Database gives that pack as 53.1 nominal / 49.0 usable. Pack match is inferred from cell count and chemistry only.
Estimated: evspecifications.com says 52.4 kWh "without explicit clarification whether gross or net" and also "not released to the market"; page unreliable.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Sibling basis: EV Database 49.0 kWh usable for the 2,976-cell Panasonic NCA pack of the Model 3 Standard Range Plus; the Model Y SR (same cell count per evspecifications) assumed to carry the same pack. A 2021 buffer change reportedly unlocked more; not applied.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: EVSpecifications: NCA, Panasonic 21700 cells; consistent with InsideEVs on California-built cars.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Page lists a 360 V pack, i.e. a 400 V-class system like the other 2170 Model Y packs.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Teslabs (2025-01) says no manual battery-preconditioning control exists, only navigating to a charger; EV Database listings say the battery is warmed automatically when navigating to a charger. Tesla manuals were not fetchable (403). Navigation preconditioning is an over-the-air software feature across Tesla models; Teslabs gives no model years. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

Estimated: Listing for the same model family says preconditioning is possible and starts automatically when navigating to a charger. Combined with the Teslabs no-manual-control statement. Tesla manuals were not readable (403). A Scheduled Precondition and Charge setting exists (seen in search excerpts of the Model Y manual), and one June 2025 Teslabs comment (Model 3) says the app can start battery warming with a Supercharger selected; no Tesla page shows a dedicated manual battery-preconditioning control, so automatic_with_navigation is kept.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: evspecifications states 170 kW DC for the Model Y SR; same pack as the Model 3 SR+, which charges at up to 170 kW (CleanTechnica 2019, src-cleantechnica-srp-170kw-2019).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Thechargeport: Standard RWD and AWD are at the 7.7 kW end of the 7.7-11.5 kW range (North America). Wikipedia says up to 11.5 kW on all variants, ArenaEV/EV Database list 11 kW (EU), so sources conflict; Tesla Model 3 service manual says 48 A only with the Long Range battery. evspecifications lists 11.5 kW for this car; the Model 3 sibling batch uses 7.7 kW (service manual: 48 A only with the Long Range battery).
